thread:
Maria L: Quick heads-up — we need to provision initial GPU capacity for a new tenant (atlas-helix). They'll run heavy evals and some model tuning. Request: p5 = 8 units, p4d = 2 units, g5 = 10 units across two regions (eu-south-2 primary, ap-south-1 secondary). Also need ENI and IPv4 NAT capacity for the accounts.
Simon K: Got it. What timeline? can we do a phased approach?
Maria L: They want pilot in ~2 weeks, full pilot scale after 6 weeks. Phased: start with 2 p5 + 1 p4d + 2 g5 in eu-south-2 for pilot, then scale up to the numbers above.
Raj P: I'll open the AWS quota cases today. Can you confirm which AWS accounts (org unit) this maps to and whether cross-account ENIs are needed?
Maria L: Mapped to aws acct: 945-helix-prod (org: enterprise-helix). Cross-account: no, single account for now. Need ENI ceiling bump on that account and a /27 nat pool suggestion (approx 32 IPs) — ops asked for cushion.
Yang C: Subnet note — eu-south-2 has limited p5 capacity historically; we should request soft limit + entitlement bump. Also need ENI limit and Elastic IPs for NAT gateway scaling.
Simon K: Can we include a fallback routing policy? If eu-south-2 can't provide p5, fall back to eu-west-3 g5 cluster with slightly higher cost. That keeps latency acceptable.
Maria L: Yes prefer fallback to eu-west-3 g5, list that in the request. Cost tradeoff acknowledged by customer.
Raj P: Filing cases now. ETA on AWS response is 48-72h usually but entitlement requests can take longer for P5/P4 families. I'll attach workload profile and expected vCPU/GPU utilization.
infra-bot: New support case opened: CASE-2026-83472 (p5/p4d/g5 quota increase). Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#CASE-2026-83472
Raj P: Submitted quota request details: regions: eu-south-2 (pilot and final), ap-south-1 (burst/fallback). Requested quotas: EC2 Accelerators: p5 -> 8 (pilot 2), p4d -> 2, g5 -> 10. ENIs: increase by +50, Elastic IPs: +10, NAT public IP pool: /27. Attached: workload matrix (token/sec estimates), expected concurrency.
Yang C: Added networking note: please ensure the subnet AZ spread covers at least 2 AZs in eu-south-2; we'll need ENI adjacency for pod packing. Also request IAM entitlement for account to attach ENIs across subnets (if needed).
Simon K: Thanks Raj — can you post the AWS case IDs here when you get them and set the case to include support-level escalation if it stalls? We'll want a follow-up runbook. :thumbsup:
Raj P: Case set with business-critical flag. Case IDs: CASE-2026-83472 (quota), CASE-2026-83473 (ENI/NAT). AWS contact assigned.
Maria L: Perfect. Also flag finance for expected monthly spend increase — pilot ~= $7k/mo, full ~= $65k/mo (est).
Yang C: I'll put a preflight checklist in the onboarding doc: subnet plan, IAM policy, AMI builds, image pull throughput, disk throughput.
Simon K: I'll track approvals and post when quotas are granted. If AWS pushes back on p5 entitlement, we'll propose phased migration to g5 + quantized models.
Maria L: Thanks everyone. Please keep this thread updated with case updates and any ask from sales/legal for contracts.
infra-bot: Ticket update (CASE-2026-83472): AWS replied requesting architecture justification and expected hourly GPU usage.
Raj P: Replying with utilization graphs and a one-page justification now.
Simon K: Noted. Follow-up reminder for next steps in 24h if no AWS response.
Maria L: tagging @Simon K and @Raj P — appreciate the fast turnaround :rocket:
